name: Hurloon Minotaurs
description: Minotaurs the Phyrexians planned to mutate; they accepted Tahngarth as their champion.

timeline.summary: Hurloon minotaurs came to Northern Aerona from Stahaan after being driven out by glaciers.
timeline.quote: These minotaurs arrived in Northern Aerona from Stahaan centuries ago after being forced from their homelands by the encroaching glaciers .

citation.text: "Minotaur", section "Hurloon Minotaurs". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Hurloon and Talruum were devastated in the Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: The Hurloon tribe, along with the Talruum, was devastated in the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria .

citation.text: "Minotaur", section "Hurloon Minotaurs". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Hurloon minotaurs find Greensleeves' crusade worthy and reveal Lat-Nam's location.
timeline.quote: the minotaurs find Greensleeves' crusade worthy and reveal the location of Lat-Nam

citation.text: "Final Sacrifice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Invasion the Talruum broke with their xenophobia to search for surviving minotaurs.
timeline.quote: In the wake of the Invasion, the Talruum broke with their traditional xenophobia to search for other surviving minotaurs along with the Hurloon.

citation.text: "Minotaur", section "Talruum Minotaurs". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hurloon minotaurs sing hymns to the dead for friend and foe alike, lasting for days.
timeline.quote: They are also known for their hymns to the dead, sung for friend and foe alike.

citation.text: Hurloon Minotaur (Oversized 90's Promos, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight destroys the Phyrexian mutation plants among the Hurloon, and survivors accept Tahngarth as their champion.
timeline.quote: the Hurloon survivors all bowed down before Tahngarth and accepted him as their champion

citation.text: "Tahngarth", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaldroom, a garrison city, was destroyed in the Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: Kaldroom - a garrison city, destroyed in the Phyrexian Invasion .

citation.text: "Aerona", section "South Aerona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Minotaurs forced from Stahaan by glaciers reach North Aerona and shelter in the Hurloon mountain caves.
timeline.quote: They had been traveling south until they encountered this impassable mountain chain, where they took shelter in the caves.

citation.text: "Hurloon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Torsten von Ursus studies minotaur philosophy in the Hurloon Mountains.
timeline.quote: Von Ursus studied minotaur philosophy in the Hurloon Mountains for several years.

citation.text: "Hurloon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexian Invasion devastates the Hurloon minotaurs and destroys Kaldroom.
timeline.quote: with the city of Kaldroom completely destroyed

citation.text: "Hurloon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Hurloon minotaurs are exiled from Stahaan as heretics for believing humans and minotaurs share a common ancestor.
timeline.quote: The Hurloon minotaurs were exiled from Stahaan as heretics

citation.text: "Stahaan", section "Stahaan Society". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
